english_name: Dragon Cloud Dream: Flame Dragon Seal (Source Edition)
english_description: By author Wenwu, an independent branch within the "Sunset Reappears / Flame Dragon Seal" (XYZX/YLFY) engine family — related to but separately evolved from this project's ylfyxa3 (Flame Dragon Seal: Smiling Proud Wanderer, Afei Station), not a reskin of the same content. It shares the genuine "Sunset Reappears" code lineage (a byte-identical d/city/sj.lpc) with xyzx, jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412; note that several other archives in this project also carry the "Sunset Reappears" brand but belong to an entirely different "Tianya" map lineage, so the brand name alone is not a reliable guide to actual codebase ancestry.
